description: This file defines a utility function to create a restart iteration hook for in-process restart loops. It manages whether the loop is on its first iteration and calls a user-provided callback on subsequent restarts.

methods.name: export function createRestartIterationHook(onRestart: () => void): () => boolean { createRestartIterationHook
